classification: reads/removes metadata-only content re: money/date (MINOR-3: an unconditional, non-financial byte-level rewrite)
what_changes: on input containing NO placeholder at all, the function still does `text.splitlines()` + `"\n".join(...)`: a CRLF line ending becomes a bare LF, and a trailing newline is dropped
what_does_not_change: every money/date/digit token; this is a byte-level normalization, never a financial or content change
semantics_note: committed as CRLF+trailing-newline in input.md and bare-LF+no-trailing-newline in expected.md specifically to demonstrate the normalization; this function still keeps METADATA_ONLY_LABEL because money/date tokens are never touched, but a byte-hash taken over the page before/after this function would differ even with no placeholder present -- worth declaring precisely because rows 1-4 are the ones nominated for first re-admission
